about: What counts as an image or a video, and how a format name is normalised. One asset for the four copies that used to be hand-kept: browser js/core/videoFrame.js, extension lib/filters.js + content/pageApiMain.js, desktop src/io/MediaLoader.cpp, cli src/video.zig + src/scrape.zig.

rules.extensions: Lowercase, WITHOUT the leading dot. `image.extensions` / `video.extensions` are the CONTRACT set — what Stencil claims to recognise.
rules.surfaces: What each surface recognises TODAY. Several are strict subsets of the contract set and no two agree; they are recorded verbatim so a surface can be wired to this asset with ZERO behaviour change, and the divergence is visible in one place instead of five. Converging them is a behaviour change and belongs to its own commit — see `drift`.
rules.normalize: Substring rewrites applied to a lowercased format/subtype token, in this order. They are SUBSTRING replacements, not whole-word: a `data:` subtype `x-jpeg` normalises to `x-jpg`.
rules.mimeOverrides: extension -> media type where `image/<ext>` is wrong. Anything absent is `image/<ext>`.
rules.extensionPattern: What may be treated as a filename extension at all: 2-5 alphanumeric characters (cli scrape.zig hasNameExt / formatOf, extension pageApiMain).
rules.accept: Ready-made values for an <input type="file" accept> attribute.

surfaceNotes.browser.videoFile: js/core/videoFrame.js isVideoFile() — matched against a File's name when its MIME type is not video/*.
surfaceNotes.browser.videoUrl: js/core/videoFrame.js isVideoUrl() — matched against a URL path; a URL carries no MIME up front.
surfaceNotes.extension.videoScan: src/content/pageApiMain.js VIDEO_FMTS — which scanned entries the page API counts as video.
surfaceNotes.extension.videoFilter: src/lib/filters.js VIDEO_FORMATS — the popup's video filter.
surfaceNotes.extension.imageFilter: src/lib/filterUi.js COMMON_FORMATS — the popup's format chips, IN DISPLAY ORDER.
surfaceNotes.desktop.image: src/io/MediaLoader.cpp isImageFileName() — what the Qt image plugins are relied on to decode.
surfaceNotes.cli.video: src/video.zig video_exts (stored there with a leading dot).

drift: No two surfaces recognise the same video set, and none matches `video.extensions`: the browser's own two lists disagree (isVideoFile has `ogg` and no `mpg`/`mpeg`; isVideoUrl the reverse), only the desktop knows `3gp`, only the cli knows `gifv`, and only the desktop and cli know `wmv`/`flv`/`ts`. Every list predates this asset. Wiring a surface to its OWN entry above is behaviour-neutral; pointing it at `video.extensions` changes what it accepts and must be its own, stated change.
